hook.text: After several records that explored jazz within hip-hop and R&B, this one turns back to hard bop.

facts.label: Recorded
facts.value: 19 to 21 September 2007, Capitol Studios, Los Angeles

facts.label: Players
facts.value: Roy Hargrove (trumpet, flugelhorn), Justin Robinson (alto saxophone, flute), Gerald Clayton (piano), Danton Boller (bass), Montez Coleman (drums)
